gdp_yoy.source: MOSPI Press Note on GDP Estimates for Q1 (Apr–Jun) 2026-27, base year 2022-23, released Aug 31, 2026 (also on PIB). Real GDP +7.8% YoY (vs revised 6.9% in Q1 FY26); flat vs Q4 FY26's 7.8%, so not trending up quarter-on-quarter. Q2 estimates due Nov 30, 2026.

cpi.source: MOSPI Press Release of CPI for October 2026 (base 2024=100, provisional), embargoed to 4 PM Nov 12, 2026. Headline 6.09% (Sep final 5.54%); rural 6.63%, urban 5.41%, food 8.94%. Breaches RBI's 6% upper tolerance band.

gsec10y.source: India 10Y benchmark G-Sec yield at 7.19% on Nov 20, 2026 (Trading Economics; Investing.com closes 7.318 on Nov 16, 7.256 on Nov 17). Down ~24 bps over the past month from the 7.45% peak on Oct 21, 2026 as crude eased. CCIL/RBI pages not reachable from this environment.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC hiked repo by 25 bps to 5.50% on Oct 7, 2026 (unanimous; first hike since Feb 2023) and shifted stance to calibrated tightening; Governor said cuts are off the table near term. Next MPC Dec 2–4, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, Oct 5–7, 2026 meeting (via RBI Bulletin/press release references, Drishti IAS 'RBI MPC Raises Repo Rate to 5.50%' Oct 9, 2026, Moneylife).

gov_capex.note: Centre's capex rose to ~₹6.5–6.55 trn in H1 FY27 (Apr–Sep 2026) vs ₹5.8 trn a year earlier, ~54% of the ₹12.22 trn FY27 target; Apr–Aug capex +18% YoY vs 14% budgeted. Pace may slow in H2 but capex push remains on track.
gov_capex.source: Controller General of Accounts H1 FY27 data via Business Standard (Oct 30, 2026) and Angel One; Jefferies note on Apr–Aug capex.

china_plus_one.note: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal at the CII Partnership Summit (Nov 12, 2026) positioned India as a reliable investment destination amid shifting global trade, targeting deeper integration into global value chains in electronics and chips; PLI covers 14 sectors. Caveat: mfg PMI hit a 5-yr low of 52.8 in Aug 2026.
china_plus_one.source: PIB statement on Goyal's address at 31st CII Partnership Summit, Visakhapatnam, Nov 12, 2026 (via secondary coverage); Times of Oman on India's rising electronics share (Aug 2026).

rural_recovery.note: SW Monsoon 2026 ended ~13% below normal; rabi sowing lagging (down ~11% YoY as of Nov 13, wheat down ~15%) on low soil moisture; rural CPI at 6.63% and food inflation 8.94% squeeze farm purchasing power. Ministry says sowing can continue till December.
rural_recovery.source: Agriculture ministry rabi sowing data via Business Today (Nov 3, 2026), PTI/The Week (Nov 6, 2026) and later reports (Nov 13 data); IMD monsoon season-end rainfall deficit; MOSPI CPI Oct 2026.
